spec.rationale: A compact compiler is the strongest economical choice because the training signal turns on the interaction between an operative recipient permission, a broad prohibition, and a bounded exception. Eleven literal clauses teach those structures without relying on source identity. The procedure recognizes recipient roles locally, gives an applicable specific permission priority over a general prohibition, joins the one explicit anaphoric recipient enumeration to its access rule, and abstains when the records do not establish the answer.
